title: Just a detail
screen: Just a detail. → Now multiply it by a thousand.
voice: All caps on a school website. Looks like a detail. Now multiply it by a thousand schools.

title: Each school alone
screen: Same duties. Each school alone. → Quality becomes a matter of chance.
voice: Every school has the same duties: accessibility, data protection, security, and rules that keep changing. Most face them alone, with their own budget and their own contractor. So quality comes down to chance.

title: Only the surface
screen: Shared digital infrastructure for schools. → The website is only the surface.
voice: Cleverphant is shared digital infrastructure for schools. What people see is the website. Underneath is what keeps it right: compliance, training, support, and a network that connects every school.

title: One notices
screen: Same benefit. Same bug. → One school notices. Every school is fixed.
voice: Because every school runs on the same system, they all get the same benefits, and the same bugs. But it takes just one school to notice. Fixed once, fixed for all.

title: Pilot → standard
screen: Ideas travel the same way. → Pilot. Data. Standard.
voice: Ideas travel the same way. A curious school leader brings a need. Their school becomes the pilot. When the data shows it works, it becomes the standard for every school.

title: Publish once
voice: And it works from the top, too. A municipality or a ministry publishes a new rule or a campaign once, and it appears on every school website at the same time.

title: Equally good
screen: Quality shouldn't depend on size. → Not identical. Equally good.
voice: A small village school gets what a large city school gets. A family changing schools finds a familiar place. The foundation is shared; the face stays the school's own. Not identical. Equally good.

title: Trojan elephant
screen: Change starts with details. → Every step opens the next.
voice: Change starts with details. Being small is no excuse to look away. Stop writing in capitals, stop stretching text, stop hiding information in images, get cookie consent right. That's our Trojan elephant, in the good sense. Once it works everywhere, we go further: a document bank, whistleblower protection, bookings, and next, AI integrations. Because AI can't work in chaos.

title: The logic of scale
screen: What works in one school works everywhere. → Not a promise of cheap. The logic of scale.
voice: What works in one school works in a municipality, a region, a whole country. Schools can be added quickly, while costs grow far more slowly. Not a promise of cheap. The logic of scale.

title: Walked this road
voice: We have walked this road for fifteen years. Hundreds of institutions, whole municipalities on one standard, with content audits, proven onboarding and a training platform. Built in a small country. Ready for yours. Let's talk about your region.
